title: Heading of the card listing the person's phones that run the Socio mobile app ("Socio" is the product name). Shown on the person's own Profile page.
intro: The card's explanation. The base form speaks to the person about their own phones; _admin is an admin looking at another person's phones (on that person's page under Settings › People). "Erasing" makes the app delete its local copy of the workspace.
empty: Shown when the person (base) or the person an admin is looking at (_admin) has never signed in on the mobile app.
list: Accessible name of the list of devices (read by screen readers).
current: Appended after the name of the device the person is using right now; keep the parentheses unless your language marks asides differently.
platforms.ios: The device's platform, shown in its details line.
details.by: In a device's details line: how its current session signed in. {{method}} is a sign-in method, such as "Passkey" or "Sign-in link", or a sign-in provider's brand name (Google, GitHub).
details.signedOut: In a device's details line: the device has no session any more.
details.eraseRequested: In a device's details line: signed out, and the app was told to delete its local copy of the workspace when it next connects.
details.since: In a device's details line: when the device first signed in. The _otherYear form adds the year for dates before this year.
methods.link: A sign-in method: a one-time link the person opened to sign in.
methods.linkEmail: A sign-in method: a one-time sign-in link sent by email.
methods.passkey: A sign-in method: a passkey (device fingerprint, face or PIN).
lastSeen.now: In a device's details line, lowercase because it follows other parts after a " · " separator: when the app last reached the server. This form: within the last ten minutes.
lastSeen.minutes: Lowercase, in a device's details line (see lastSeen.now). "min" is short for minutes.
lastSeen.hours: Lowercase, in a device's details line (see lastSeen.now). "h" is short for hours.
lastSeen.date: Lowercase start, in a device's details line (see lastSeen.now): for more than five weeks ago. The _otherYear form adds the year.
signOut.button: Button on a device's row that opens the sign-out confirmation.
signOut.label: Accessible name of the sign-out button; {{device}} is the device's name, such as "Ada’s iPhone".
signOut.title: Title of the confirmation dialog; {{device}} is the device's name.
signOut.body: What signing out does. Base form: the person's own device; _admin: an admin acting on another person's device.
signOut.done: Toast after the device was signed out; {{device}} is its name.
erase.button: Button on a device's row: sign the device out and have the app delete its local copy of the workspace.
erase.label: Accessible name of the erase button; {{device}} is the device's name.
erase.body: What erasing does: the app deletes its copy, including drafts not sent yet. Base form: the person's own device; _admin: an admin acting on another person's device.
erase.done: Toast after the device was signed out; the app deletes its copy when it next connects.
